caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally within a square outline on a beige or light brown textured background. The object is a pewter oil lamp, consisting of three main parts: a shallow, dish-like base; a curving, bulbous stem; and a cylindrical reservoir that sits on top of the stem. The reservoir has a slightly flared rim at the top and a brass or gold-colored cap or wick holder protruding centrally from the top. The lamp is rendered in muted, bluish-gray tones consistent with pewter metal, while the wick holder is depicted in a yellow or brass color. Below and to the left of the square outline, text reads “CASE #2. No. 1, LAMP,” and to the right “PEWTER LAMP, SANDERS 1948.” The drawing is signed “Eugene Bartlett” at the bottom right outside the square.
title: Pewter Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
